sahneler.gorsel_prompt: Low-angle realistic smartphone photo of a man's lower legs standing on a dry paved city sidewalk outside an autumn cafe. The man wears pristine white low-top leather court sneakers with a clean white rubber cupsole, white laces, and a contrasting black heel tab accent, paired with charcoal tailored trousers cropped just above the ankle. October afternoon soft daylight, scattered dry autumn leaves softly blurred in the background, frame cropped from mid-calf down with no face visible, authentic mobile phone camera look.
sahneler.hareket_prompt: Gentle 8-second handheld camera movement slowly panning around the shoes at ground level. The subject stands calmly, subtly shifting weight between his feet on the sidewalk, keeping the all-white sneakers prominent, sharp, and steady in frame.

sahneler.gorsel_prompt: Eye-level realistic smartphone perspective looking down at a man sitting relaxed on outdoor concrete stone steps in an urban courtyard. He wears crisp all-white minimalist low-top leather sneakers with solid flat white soles and a subtle black heel tab, paired with dark navy straight-leg denim. One sneaker rests on the step below while the other rests flat on the step above, with the shoes filling the lower center frame. Soft diffused autumn light, realistic mobile lens quality, no face in frame.
sahneler.hareket_prompt: Smooth 8-second handheld micro-push towards the sneakers resting calmly on the stairs. The subject remains seated and still, with natural light subtly reflecting off the clean white leather as the camera maintains gentle organic movement.
